source_excerpt:
BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification is out for 350 Electronics and Mechanical vacancies. Eligible candidates can apply online from October 28 to November 18, 2026. Check this article for eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee, selection process and application steps.
BEL announced 350 Probationary Engineer vacancies in Electronics & Mechanical disciplines.
Online applications open from October 28, 2026, and close on November 18, 2026.
Selection includes a CBT tentatively on December 22, 2026, followed by an interview.
BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) a Navaratna PSU under the ministry of defense has released the official notification for 350 P robationary Engineer vacancies in Electronics and Mechanical disciplines. The online application process will start from October 28, 2026 and eligible candidates can submit their forms until November 18, 2026 . The selection process comprises Computer Based Test (85 Marks) followed by Interview process (15 Marks). The test is set to be tentatively conducted on December 22, 2026.
Here you will find all the important information related to the application process, eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee and other details before applying.
BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
BEL has published the detailed recruitment notification under Advertisement No. 17556/HR/All-India/2026. The notification contains information about vacancies, educational qualifications, age relaxation, the selection process and application guidelines. Candidates can refer to the official notification once before submitting their applications. Check the BEL Recruitment 2026 notification pdf from the table below.

BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
Candidates must fulfil the educational qualification and age requirements specified in the official notification to apply for the available posts. Check details below.
Candidates must hold a first class B.E, B.Tech. or four-year B.Sc. Engineering degree from an AICTE-approved college in the relevant discipline. Eligible specialisations for Electronics include Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Electronics and Telecommunication, Communication and Telecommunication.
